frase_clave: Untrained teams often try to apply remedies before the causes are known. ("Ready, fire, aim.")
razon: Tiene razon el LECTOR B. El paso 'No aplicar ningun remedio sin evidencia validada de la causa real' es una parafrasis del libro sin nada anadido. El titulo del apartado es 'Diagnosis Should Precede Remedy' (L7171). El libro define 'cause' como 'a proved reason for the existence of a defect' (L7159) y 'Diagnosis' como el proceso de 'testing theories, and discovering causes' (L7163). Tambien presenta como error aplicar remedios 'before the causes are known' (L7178). Por tanto, 'evidencia validada de la causa' es exactamente lo que el libro llama causa, frente a 'theory' o 'unproven assertions' (L7157). En L14594 y L18954 el libro insiste en las 'proven root causes'. El paso no anade accion, objeto, condicion, cifra ni herramienta. Es la misma regla en forma negativa, asi que no es una concrecion operativa sino una parafrasis. El LECTOR A cito bien el pasaje, pero la etiqueta OPERATIVO le sobra.

razon: Tiene razon el LECTOR B. El libro usa la Poisson acumulada para calcular probabilidades en el muestreo de un lote de proveedor (L11988) y la probabilidad de aceptar un lote para construir la curva OC de un plan de muestreo (L24935-L24939, ejemplo n = 125, c = 5, Pa = 0.616). El paso lleva ese calculo a la decision de aceptar lotes. Va en la misma direccion y no anade datos, pero no es parafrasis directa: es OPERATIVO.

libro: Juran's Quality Handbook_ The C - Joseph A. Defeo
frase_clave: The planning for quality control should provide an information network that can serve all decision makers. At some levels of the hierarchy, a major need is for real-time information to permit prompt detection and correction of nonconformance to goals. At other levels, the emphasis is on summaries that enable leaders to exercise control over the vital few control subjects.
razon: Tiene razon el LECTOR A. El libro no se limita a describir la diferencia entre niveles: prescribe la accion. Dice que la planificacion del control de calidad debe dar una red de informacion que sirva a todos los que deciden, con informacion en tiempo real en unos niveles y resumenes en otros, y que eso 'requires planning that is directed specifically at the information system' (L8358). Definir que informacion va en tiempo real y cual en resumen segun el nivel es justo esa planificacion, dicha con otras palabras. Lo de 'periodicos' lo respalda L8356: 'regularly publish scoreboards showing summarized quality performance data'. El paso no anade accion, objeto ni condicion, asi que es FIEL y no OPERATIVO.

razon: Las preguntas de Baker piden identificar al cliente inmediato y saber como usa lo que recibe. Preguntarselo directamente concreta eso (el libro menciona enterarse por el cliente en el punto v).

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: The numbers read out designate by serial number the selection of the sample.
razon: Es el ultimo paso de la definicion operacional: los numeros leidos identifican las unidades de la muestra.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Your factory runs on piece work. There is no better assurance of defective workmanship.
razon: El libro senala el pago por pieza como causa de mala calidad.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Is every job in a job shop done better than the one before?
razon: Es literal, parafraseado.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Improvement of quality and productivity, to be successful in any company, must be a learning process, year by year, top management leading the whole company.
razon: Es literal, parafraseado.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: purchase based on evidence of quality as well as on price
razon: Las compras se deciden por evidencia estadistica de calidad, no solo por precio.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: k1 = cost to inspect one part; k2 = cost to dismantle, repair, reassemble, and test an assembly that fails because a defective part was put into the production line
razon: Son las definiciones del libro.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: From now on, there will be a system by which employees may report trouble with machines or with materials and by which these reports will receive attention.
razon: Tiene razon el lector A. El libro describe casi palabra por palabra un sistema para que los empleados avisen de fallos en maquinas o materiales y para que esos avisos se atiendan. Eso es el canal de reporte con seguimiento real. B cita pasajes generales (L1598) y pasa por alto esta frase literal. El adjetivo 'simple' no cambia el sentido.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: What would happen if you did not do your job right?
razon: Son las preguntas iii y v de Baker.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: The aim of supervision should be to help people and machines and gadgets to do a better job.
razon: El libro redefine la supervision como ayuda y acompanamiento.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: It had never occurred to him that his people are part of the system, and that he is responsible for them
razon: El responsable del sistema es el dueno, no quien ayuda.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Use the measurements to plot a run chart or other statistical chart ... to discover whether the process is in statistical control.
razon: Es literal.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: We can tolerate only a few parts in Case 2 (100 percent inspection) ... We can tolerate for the remaining parts only quality at or close to zero defective.
razon: Es literal, parafraseado.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Who is the customer (the next stage), and how can we serve better the customer?
razon: Tiene razon el lector B. El libro pide averiguar quien es el cliente, que es la etapa siguiente, y como servirle mejor. L1841 lo repite ('Any stage has a customer, the next stage'), y L1361 anade 'Why not get acquainted with the customer?'. Identificar al cliente inmediato y lo que necesita es una parafrasis directa.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: A flow diagram of any process will divide the work into stages. ... Any stage has a customer, the next stage.
razon: Es parafrasis directa del apartado 4 del Punto 14.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: good agreement between independent results of two men would only mean that they have a system. It would not mean that they are both right.
razon: Es literal.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: They prepared a comparison of the cost of some actual repair jobs and the cost to prevent the problem in the first place.
razon: Es literal.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Mr. Edison's output, a faster vote, was not compatible with the objectives of the Congress.
razon: El libro usa esos dos ejemplos para separar output de objetivo.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Anybody can pay dividends by deferring maintenance, cutting out research, or acquiring another company.
razon: Es literal, parafraseado.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: the main causes of trouble belong to the system, which is for Bill to work on.
razon: El libro pide actuar sobre el sistema y no culpar a las personas.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Eliminate management by objective. Eliminate management by numbers, numerical goals. Substitute leadership.
razon: El libro pide abolir la gestion por numeros y la calificacion anual. Eliminar la evaluacion punitiva basada solo en numeros va en esa direccion.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: A better plan would be for each man to record on his own form his judgment concerning each patient
razon: El libro propone que cada inspector o medico registre su juicio por separado y luego se comparen (tambien L10001).

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Management must go through new learning.
razon: Tiene razon el lector B. El libro exige a la direccion aprender cosas nuevas (L1808). Tambien pide al directivo aprender en persona, sin 'short-circuit his need for learning' (L1575), y aprender sus responsabilidades bajo la nueva filosofia (L522). Ademas atribuye el exito japones a 'their eagerness to learn' (L10873). El paso lo dice en forma de compromiso, sin anadir nada.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Restrictions on weight and size may of course not permit redundancy.
razon: Es literal, parafraseado.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: is to suppose that every event (defect, mistake, accident) is attributable to someone ... The fact is that most troubles with service and production lie in the system.
razon: El libro advierte contra culpar a alguien sin mirar primero el sistema.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Experience will answer a question, and a question comes from theory. The theory in hand need not be elaborate. It may be only a hunch, or a statement of principles.
razon: El libro pide partir de una teoria, aunque sea una corazonada o unos principios, para preguntar a la experiencia. Formularla antes de actuar lo concreta.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Under this plan, a man cannot be promoted for justifying bad statistical practice proposed by the division.
razon: El libro da ese proposito del doble reporte para las malas practicas estadisticas. Extenderlo a las operativas es una ampliacion en la misma direccion, sin cifra ni herramienta nueva.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: The well-known "Quality Circle" concept, involving small teams of 5-15 employees, was widely observed.
razon: Tiene razon el lector A. La cifra de 5 a 15 esta en el libro, asi que no es ANADIDO, pero aparece como observacion de un estudio sobre plantas japonesas y no como instruccion. Tampoco es CONTRARIO. El libro advierte contra copiar los circulos de calidad sin que la direccion actue (L2809, L2944), pero los apoya: 'QC-Circles that enjoy cooperation and action by management will do well anywhere' (L2809) y 'A good place to start a QC-Circle' (L2962). El paso convierte esa observacion en una indicacion en la misma direccion.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: I spoke with 45 production workers about the inhibitors that stand in their way to improvement of quality and productivity.
razon: Es literal, parafraseado.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: If the chart indicates reasonably good statistical control, one may conclude that the defective parts were made by the same system that made the good ones.
razon: Primero se comprueba el control estadistico y despues se actua sobre el sistema.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Improvement of a process may require study of records to learn more about the effects of changes in temperature, pressure, speed, change of material.
razon: Es literal.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: send out questionnaires to only a sample of a thousand purchasers, appropriately selected
razon: El libro propone enviar el cuestionario solo a una muestra bien seleccionada.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: our terminal manager travelled with a different driver each day.
razon: En el caso Reimer, el gerente acompana al chofer y descubre asi el problema real.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: a sample of a thousand purchasers, appropriately selected
razon: La cifra de 1000 viene del libro.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Now, only 1 item in 20 has two or more vendors. (One in 20 may be close to an irreducible minimum.)
razon: El libro pide ir hacia un unico proveedor por articulo (L526), pero acepta como minimo irreducible algunos articulos con dos o mas y habla de menos proveedores (L1463). Por eso 'uno o muy pocos' no contradice el libro.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Then, when convenient, compare notes. The young man may then without confrontation ask questions
razon: Los registros se comparan despues, sin confrontacion ni miedo.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: the same simple statistical tools can be used to tell management how much of the proportion of defective material is chargeable to common (environmental) causes
razon: El libro calcula que proporcion de los defectos se debe al sistema.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: an orderly study of productivity, to enquire whether any given activity is consistent with the aim of the organization, and what it is costing
razon: Es literal, parafraseado.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Overall improvement ... will depend entirely on changes in the system, such as equipment, materials, training.
razon: El libro pide actuar sobre el sistema con mejores materiales, equipo y mantenimiento, y da el ejemplo del hilo (L8653).

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: These men were out in the plants at work.
razon: Tiene razon el lector A. En L10883 el libro describe a los directivos japoneses en planta, sin dar una orden. Pide al directivo aprender de su gente lo que hace (L1575) y pregunta a disenadores y compradores 'Why not spend time in the factory, see the problems' (L1361). Estar presente donde se hace el trabajo concreta eso. No es CONTRARIO: la critica al MBWA (L501) va contra pasearse sin saber que preguntar, no contra ir a entender el proceso. Pero tampoco es literal para el directivo, asi que no llega a FIEL.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: To simplify the system of charges for his product. It is too complicated.
razon: Es el mismo ejemplo de los descuentos.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Where in the total organizational structure does your department fit? What products and services does it provide?
razon: Son las preguntas de Baker.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Leaders must know the work that they supervise.
razon: El libro exige que el lider conozca el trabajo que supervisa. Capacitarlo para ello concreta esa exigencia.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Take a bundle from the top, middle, bottom, scattering the selections. (This would be what we have already called mechanical sampling, not use of random numbers.)
razon: Es el paso 1 del plan de los inspectores de cuero.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: My suggestion was to send the form back immediately to the buyer if anything was amiss.
razon: Es literal, parafraseado.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: send the voucher back to the traveler for correction, with an explanation that his omission may cause delay in reimbursement.
razon: El libro devuelve el documento con una explicacion de la demora que causa.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Start as soon as possible to construct with deliberate speed an organization to guide continual improvement of quality
razon: Es parafrasis directa del apartado 5 del Punto 14.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Never-ending improvement in manufacturing means continual work with vendors and eventual reduction to one vendor and one shipping point for any one item
razon: Es literal, parafraseado.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Where do you hope to be five years from now? How may you reach this goal? By what method?
razon: Es literal.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: n unduplicated random numbers between l and N
razon: Es literal.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: your tests of the final product: Are these tests in statistical control? If not, they will mislead you.
razon: Es literal, parafraseado.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: The key observation was that the trouble was common to all machines and to all operators. ... A few tests showed that it was the thread that caused the trouble.
razon: Pruebas simples para aislar la causa comun.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Move toward a single supplier for any one item, on a long-term relationship of loyalty and trust.
razon: El libro pide reducir de forma progresiva hasta un unico proveedor por articulo (tambien L1116).

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: The mechanics accordingly drew a flow diagram of the process for repair of vehicles. They collected data to determine how much time was required to complete each step.
razon: Es literal.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Both inspectors will examine and record their results independently for every 20th bundle.
razon: La cifra de cada 20 viene del libro.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: There must be continual improvement in test methods (p. 120), and ever better understanding of the customer's needs
razon: Es literal, parafraseado.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Arrange the M terms of the series in descending order of magnitude. ... No inspection for parts for which ki - Kpi is positive.
razon: Es el ejercicio 4 del libro.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: What management needs are charts to show whether the system has reached a stable state ... or it is still infested with special causes
razon: Es literal, parafraseado.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: You are thinking about measuring waste and productivity at the end. It is better to work on the processes, and on equipment and on materials and components that go into your product
razon: Es parafrasis directa del pasaje del Punto 5.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Will they refer to tomorrow's run or to next year's crop?
razon: Son las preguntas del libro.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: In return for steelmakers' cooperation with GM in its cost-cutting objectives, the auto maker is expected to reward suppliers with multi-year contracts.
razon: El libro respalda los contratos plurianuales (tambien L1063, hasta seis anos), pero no menciona en ningun sitio la transparencia total de costos ni los 'open books'. Lo busque con open book, transparen, disclos y cost data.
texto_sugerencia: Sugerencia de My Idea: establecer contratos de largo plazo (varios años) con transparencia total de costos ('open books')

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: k1/k2 = break-even quality, or break-even point
razon: Es literal.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Case 1: If p < k1/k2, no inspection; Case 2: If p > k1/k2, 100 percent inspection
razon: Es la regla del todo o nada.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: If k1 < pk2, then 100 percent inspection, not sampling inspection, would minimize total cost.
razon: Es literal.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: through improvement of processes, his company was producing three times as much PAS ... with the same people, same machines, same plant, same materials.
razon: El libro mejora el proceso sin cambiar personal ni equipo.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: He is responsible only for the special causes chargeable to him.
razon: Tiene razon el lector A. L7460 dice literalmente que el trabajador solo responde de las causas especiales a su cargo. L9139 anade la comunicacion: 'The benefit of this communication with the worker, if he perceives a genuine attempt on the part of management to show him what his job is, and to hold him responsible for what he himself can govern, and not for the sins of management'. El libro ya pone el acto de comunicarlo, asi que no hay nada que concretar.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: You have a slogan, posted everywhere, urging everyone to do perfect work, nothing else. ... You must provide methods to help the hourly worker to improve his work
razon: El libro critica el lema de trabajo perfecto sin metodo y pide eliminar lemas y exhortaciones (L538, L1465: metas sin hoja de ruta). El paso va en esa direccion.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Study of complaints is certainly necessary but it gives a biased picture of performance of a product or of a service.
razon: Es literal, parafraseado.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: A simple chart like Fig. 51 will display agreements and disagreements.
razon: Es literal.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: it means do not take action on the remaining ups and downs, as to do so would create additional variation and more trouble
razon: Tiene razon el lector B. El libro dice que solo se actua ante la senal de una causa especial y que el resto se deja, porque actuar anadiria variacion (L7458). Los graficos 'tell the operator when to take action ... and when to leave it alone' (L9133). La estabilidad se logra 'eliminating special causes one by one on statistical signal' (L7695). El paso es la parafrasis directa como regla de ajuste.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: this evaluation can be carried out with accuracy by statistical methods of sampling
razon: El libro usa la muestra para estimar el estado del conjunto.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Number the units in the frame 1, 2, 3, and onward to N.
razon: Es literal.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: We shall speak of faults of the system as common causes of trouble, and faults from fleeting events as special causes.
razon: Es literal.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: it is only necessary to keep an eye on the state of statistical control and on the average fraction defective
razon: Tiene razon el lector A. El libro pide vigilar el estado de control estadistico de los lotes que llegan para saber si caen en el Caso 1 o en el Caso 2 (L9306). Advierte que no inspeccionar 'is not a directive to proceed in ignorance' y pide graficos de control llevados junto con el proveedor (L9285). L7849 confirma que las reglas de todo o nada exigen control estadistico. Revisar si lo que llega esta en control estadistico es literal.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Eliminate numerical goals, slogans, and posters imploring people to do better. Instead, display accomplishments of the management
razon: Es literal, parafraseado.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: to the head of the division for day-by-day output of procedures and analysis, and to the statistical leader for his statistical work and continuing education.
razon: Es literal, parafraseado.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Top management will understand that my work is companywide.
razon: Es literal.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Think of the chaos that would come if everyone did his best, not knowing what to do.
razon: Es literal, parafraseado.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Management in authority will struggle over every one of the above 13 points, the deadly diseases, the obstacles (Ch. 3). They will agree on their meaning and on the direction to take.
razon: Es el paso 1 del Punto 14.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: He will have authority from top management to be a participant in any activity that in his judgment is worth his pursuit. He will be a regular participant in any major meeting of the president and staff.
razon: El libro pide que el lider estadistico participe en toda reunion importante y en cualquier actividad. Nombrar diseno, compras y control de calidad concreta eso sin dato nuevo.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: Management may disregard early warning from tests conducted by the company's own engineers, and reports of trouble from customers.
razon: Tiene razon el lector A. El libro culpa a la direccion de ignorar las alertas de las pruebas de sus propios ingenieros y los avisos de problemas de los clientes por prisa en sacar el producto. El paso convierte esa critica en una accion positiva y amplia 'los ingenieros' a 'quien trabaja contigo'. Va en la misma direccion y no trae datos nuevos, pero no es una parafrasis estricta.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: quality must be built in at the design stage. It may be too late, once plans are on their way. Every product should be regarded as one of a kind; there is only one chance for optimum success.
razon: Es cita casi literal del Punto 5.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: when the incoming quality will dependably lie predominantly on one side of the break-even quality, adoption of any plan of inspection other than the all-or-none rules runs the risk of increase of overall cost.
razon: Es literal, parafraseado.

libro: Out of the Crisis, Reissue - Deming, W. Edwards; Cahill, Kev
frase_clave: to plot the fraction defective day by day over the past six weeks
razon: El libro usa datos diarios de varias semanas.

libro: Quality is free _ the art of making quality certain -- Philip B_ Crosby
frase_clave: Each inspection or test brings about two results. First, the product is either accepted or rejected; and second, the measurement itself must be recorded.
razon: El libro exige registrar la medicion de cada inspeccion o prueba; el paso lo dice parafraseado.

libro: Quality is free _ the art of making quality certain -- Philip B_ Crosby
frase_clave: Ask if you can perform any specific service for the general manager.
razon: Punto 3 de la tarjeta de auditoria de Halden.

libro: Quality is free _ the art of making quality certain -- Philip B_ Crosby
frase_clave: Trends are less obvious; they require detective work that may involve lab analysis and other kinds of sleuthing.
razon: El analisis de tendencias es la fuente para los problemas menos obvios.

libro: Quality is free _ the art of making quality certain -- Philip B_ Crosby
frase_clave: They don't understand or believe a fundamental truth: you have to have something to say.
razon: Contenido antes que forma es la verdad fundamental de la transmision.

libro: Quality is free _ the art of making quality certain -- Philip B_ Crosby
frase_clave: Select team personnel at random from a Jury list of other operations. Don't insist that everyone on the team be a specialist in the function to be audited. They are guaranteed to come equipped with their own set of blinders.
razon: El libro pide auditores sin interes en el resultado, tomados de otras operaciones, y no exigir que todos sean especialistas por sus anteojeras; el paso lo concreta como evitar especialistas, en la misma direccion y sin datos nuevos.

libro: Quality is free _ the art of making quality certain -- Philip B_ Crosby

razon: Tenia razon el LECTOR A. El libro pide literalmente 'look past these preconceptions', es decir, dejar la idea de que la gestion es lo contrario de lo innovador (L81). Insiste en que una startup 'must be managed' aunque la gente vea el proceso y la gestion como aburridos (L163), y en que evitar toda gestion, proceso y disciplina lleva al caos (L218, L224). frase_clave: The first tests customer perception of the problem and the customer's need to solve it. [...] The second phase shows customers the product for the first time
razon: Tenía razón el lector A. El paso («Prueba cómo percibe el cliente el problema antes de mostrarle nada del producto») parafrasea L856: la primera fase prueba cómo percibe el cliente el problema y la segunda le muestra el producto «for the first time». Si el producto aparece por primera vez en la segunda fase, antes no se ha enseñado. L8626 (repetido en L20492) lo confirma: «After testing the customer problem (or need) [...] it's time to expose the product itself to potential customers for the first time». Por tanto «nada del producto» no añade condición: repite lo que el libro dice. El lector B apoya su matiz en dos pasajes que no lo contradicen. En L20232 solo se presenta «only the big idea» de la solución, no el producto, y el libro separa esa presentación del problema de la presentación del producto («In contrast with a product presentation, a problem presentation», L20166). En L7942, el MVP de baja fidelidad para web es una variante del canal digital y sirve para recoger opiniones sobre el problema. No cambia la secuencia general del libro (problema primero, producto después). Como no hay dato nuevo ni secuencia cambiada, el paso es FIEL y no solo OPERATIVO.

razon: Tiene razon el lector B. El libro pide de forma explicita fijar la definicion del producto antes del Desarrollo: los cinco elementos, entre ellos los "high-level specifications", deben estar "clearly defined, written down, fact based, and agreed to by all parties prior to entering the Development stage" (L1645, L1659), con "no moving goalposts" (L1665). Tambien matiza que el "100 percent design freeze" esta obsoleto en algunos mercados, pero que algunos elementos "can indeed be nailed down before Development begins" y pide separar lo "known and fixed" de lo variable (L1669, L1677). El paso dice congelar solo las especificaciones clave antes del desarrollo, que es una parafrasis directa de fijar (nail down) las especificaciones de alto nivel y los elementos conocidos antes del Desarrollo. No anade accion, objeto ni condicion: congelar equivale a nail down o fixed, y especificaciones clave recoge high-level specifications. Busque en todo el libro (frozen, freeze, locked in, nailed down): los pasajes de L4623, L4639 y L4835 critican congelar TODA la especificacion en el modelo rigido, no fijar las clave, asi que no hay contradiccion. El lector A reconoce la misma direccion pero lo rebaja a OPERATIVO sin senalar ningun dato que no este en el libro.

En L2835 dice que lo invertido no debe subir si la incertidumbre no baja. La regla 5 (L2857) pide puntos de evaluacion antes de pasar a la siguiente etapa: "Should you proceed to the next stage, or kill the project now?". Pero el libro no manda literalmente evaluar el nivel de incertidumbre actual antes de asignar recursos a la siguiente etapa. Da la regla y las gates, y el paso convierte eso en un acto concreto de comprobacion. Busque con Grep en todo el libro assess, evaluate, gauge o measure junto a uncertainty o risk, y uncertainty before o prior, y no hay ninguna formulacion literal. Por eso no es FIEL. Tampoco agrega cifras, plazos, herramientas ni responsables, asi que no es ANADIDO, y nada en el libro lo contradice. Es una concrecion sin datos nuevos: OPERATIVO.

El paso ('Identificar tecnologias emergentes con rendimiento inicial inferior pero con potencial disruptivo') parafrasea L8129 ('Be sure to identify potential disruptive technologies'). El rasgo de rendimiento inicial inferior es la definicion que el propio libro da de esas tecnologias en L8125 ('innovations that result in worse performance, at least in the near term') y en L5223 ('often yield products with inferior performance initially'). L8129 insiste ademas en no descartarlas 'simply because the initial products offer poor performance', y L5247 pide 'identify technologies that might address your current customers' needs better'. El paso no anade accion, objeto ni condicion: es la instruccion del libro dicha con otras palabras, no una concrecion, asi que FIEL y no OPERATIVO.

En L1291-L1293 presenta el producto me-too, 'much the same as competitors'', como la primera causa de fracaso, y pone como modelo rechazar el proyecto que no esta diferenciado. En L2725 dice que los criterios de gate sobre superioridad 'may also rightly kill some major projects where no competitive advantage exists'. 'No avances con un proyecto si es simplemente una copia de algo que ya existe' es una parafrasis directa de esas frases, sin anadir accion, objeto ni condicion. La estrategia de seguidor rapido que el libro acepta (L8399) exige 'bring a superior product to market', no una copia, asi que no contradice el paso.
